description: Ends an app early by updating its term so it expires within about an hour. The network then uninstalls it everywhere. With confirm=true this signs and pays the (usually minimal) update; without it, returns the plan.

fluxIdPrivateKey.description: WIF private key of the Flux ID that owns the app. Use a dedicated key from flux_generate_keys, never a main wallet key.

paymentPrivateKey.description: WIF private key of the Flux address that pays. Fund it with only what you intend to spend.

name: flux_cancel_app
title: Cancel an app (stop it and stop paying)
